name: Stairwell
desc1: This small, plain chamber is warmly lit by a pair of lanterns affixed
desc2: to the walls. The wooden stairwell curves up through the ceiling to
desc3: the second floor, and archways to the kitchen and foyer lead out to
desc4: the north and east. A strange iron box by the stairwell accepts room
desc5: tickets for anyone wishing to go upstairs to rest.
